records.name: Moving Brain
records.notes: IRS lists this as a nonprofit (2527 S Ashford St), but the website sells paid services: children's clinical therapy for Pennsylvania residents, and yoga and mindfulness workshops that schools and camps book (from $10 per child). It also mentions classes and trainings with no details or dates. No open community program found, so it is treated as a business. Re-check if the classes turn out to be open to the public.

records.name: Muslim Youth of Philadelphia
records.summary: A youth-led group that gives young Muslims a faith-based place to learn and grow. Its Weekend Islamic School teaches children Quran memorization, Arabic, and Islamic studies, and the group also runs mentoring, service, and sports activities.
records.what_you_do: Families can enroll children in the weekend school. The group also runs community service, mentorship, and sports programs, and it is asking for help to build a youth center.

schedule.text: A weekend Islamic school for children. The home page does not list days or times.

first_step.how: Open the Learn More page for the Weekend Islamic School on the group's website and ask how to enroll your child

records.notes: The site has no dated items and no contact details. The founding month, January 2019, is not treated as a sign of life. The batch's IRS address (6634 Woodland Ave, 19142) is not published because the site gives no location. The faith entry reflects the stated focus on young Muslims; check whether the school is open to all families.

records.name: New Generation Empowerment Ministries
records.summary: A nonprofit that helps young adults ages 18 to 30 meet basic needs and build their well-being through education, programs, and services, across eight areas of wellness.
records.what_you_do: Young adults can ask for support, volunteer, or donate through the group's website. The home page does not describe its programs in detail.

first_step.how: Use the Volunteer or Get Support page on ngem.org, or email the group at NewGem116@gmail.com, to ask how to get involved
first_step.basis: The site links to Volunteer and Get Support pages but does not explain how to join, so the way in is unclear from the home page.

records.notes: The batch lists this as a congregation. The site describes a service nonprofit for ages 18 to 30 and shows no worship, so it is recorded as nonprofit. No dated items on the site. The IRS mailing address (Po Box 33448, 19142) differs from the address on the site, which is the one published.

records.name: Prepared Place Ministries
records.summary: A 501(c)(3) that trains and supports women affected by incarceration, both inside and outside prison. It also serves their families and works with churches and local service providers.
records.what_you_do: Volunteer through the Volunteer page, sign up for the newsletter, or request a speaker. The site describes a mentorship program called Chill Out but does not say how to enroll.

cost.text: No program fee listed; the site asks for donations

first_step.how: Use the Volunteer page at preparedplaceministries.org, or sign up for the newsletter on the home page, to ask how to help
first_step.basis: The site has a clear Volunteer page and a newsletter sign-up, though it does not explain how program enrollment works.

records.notes: The only date on the site is a 2016 copyright footer, which is not treated as evidence. records.name: The River Church
records.summary: A Christian church on Island Avenue in Philadelphia with Sunday worship, a Thursday night midweek service, and programs for children, youth, singles, and the arts.
records.what_you_do: Come to Sunday worship or to Midweek Manna on Thursday at 7 pm. Children and youth go to their own classes after the first part of Sunday worship. The site lists leaders for dance, arts, and singles ministries but does not say how to sign up.

schedule.text: Sunday morning worship, Midweek Manna every Thursday at 7 pm, and children's and youth classes during Sunday services

first_step.how: Come to Thursday Midweek Manna at 7 pm or Sunday worship at 3751 Island Avenue. Children go to their classes after the first part of worship.
first_step.basis: The site says its doors are always open and invites new people to worship, but it does not describe a newcomer program.

records.notes: The batch name is Present Truth Ministries, the IRS legal name (EIN 263565722, Po Box 16848, 19142). The denomination is not stated, so faith is left empty.

records.name: YOURpath for Adult Learners
records.summary: A nonprofit offering online study help for the GED, HiSET, and TABE tests, plus literacy, math, digital skills, and job readiness courses. The classes are open to adults across the country who did not finish high school or have low reading skills, and they run online at any hour.
records.what_you_do: Enroll in an online class from the Enroll Here page and study on your own schedule. Adults can also join the mailing list for updates.

cost.text: Fees are not shown on the home page

first_step.how: Open the Enroll Here page on yourpathforadultlearners.com to sign up for an online class
first_step.basis: Courses are open to adults through a clear enroll page, but the home page does not list prices or how long courses run.

records.notes: National online program. The site lists no street address; the IRS filing shows 8122 Buist Ave (19153), which is not confirmed as a local office. Published as a publish record because any Philadelphia adult can enroll online, not because it meets in the city; a reviewer may want to move it to out_of_area. The site has no dated items, so status is probably_active. The 2015 and 2018 dates on the page are not used. The Opportunities link in the footer was not checked.

first_step.basis: Volunteering has a clear public survey, but the page does not explain how people enter the housing or reentry programs.

notes: Budget: 2 of 2 WebSearch used, both for the two IRS groups with no web address (Philadelphia Leadership Foundation and Alpha Omega Alpha at Temple). 19 WebFetch used. Three groups could not be read (Family Childcare Coalition, Technology Project for African Schools, Wodoe Foundation): those are status unknown with no summary, so they are held back, and they need a manual check or a search. Verdicts: 12 publish (4 of them unknown and held back), 1 out_of_area, 1 hide, 1 not_a_group. Judgment calls: Moving Brain is treated as a paid service business; Present Truth Ministries is written as The River Church and matched by the batch website; NGEM and Prepared Place are recorded as nonprofit, not congregation, because their sites describe service groups; Sheikh Kafumba is out of area (Liberia); YOURpath is kept as a national online program, flagged in its notes; Alpha Omega Alpha is hidden as private. Eight publish records are probably_active from working sites with no dated items, since copyright footers were not used as evidence. No leads_only items were found with their own website.
